casa.titulo: Be on time and clock in
casa.texto: Be at the workstation at the starting time, not walking through the door. Always clock in and out.
Mandatory in the whole warehouse. Without safety shoes you cannot enter the working area.
The phone stays in your locker or in your pocket. Use it only during the break and in the canteen.

casa.titulo: Keep your things in the locker
casa.texto: Backpacks, big bags and coats are not allowed in the working area. Use the lockers provided: that is how you keep your workspace clear.

casa.titulo: No eating or drinking on the line
casa.texto: Only water in a closed bottle. Food is eaten in the canteen.
Not when you are in a hurry, not at the end of the shift. Most accidents happen while running.
If you are ill or will be late, report it before the shift starts through the channel you were given.

ompak.texto: An item that is not scanned does not exist for the system. Never put a product in the box without scanning it.
Do not mix items from two different orders in the same box, even if they go to the same place.
Look at the screen and at the box: same item, same quantity. Closing is the last step, not the first.
A broken, dirty or opened product is not sent. Report it with F1 and put it in the damaged goods trolley.

ompak.titulo: No boxes with unreadable or missing labels
ompak.texto: If the label is marked with a pen, torn or blurred on one side or on both, take the box out and put it with the used boxes at the office window.

ompak.titulo: Do not leave your session open
ompak.texto: When you leave the station, log out. The production of the next person would be added to your name.
Only the current order on the table. Cardboard goes to the cardboard line and plastic straight into the right container.

ompak.titulo: Change the knife blade in the right place
ompak.texto: The blade is changed strictly at the office window and the used one goes into the container provided for it. Changing it at the workstation is not allowed.
